validation_log.result: Broader acceptance remains only partially substantiated despite the green regression gate. Flood route tests walk to high ground BEFORE starting the warning, so they prove walkability and peak refuge safety, not escape while water rises. Collapse tests/selection preserve one paired piece but do not execute relocation to it under active Flood+Earthquake. The map tornado-reach test accepts distance <=15m while the runtime influence radius defaults to 8m; this assertion is not proof of actual exposure (no safe-camping exploit reproduced). Timed escape, post-collapse relocation and actual refuge exposure need focused executed scenarios before claiming full fairness verification. Archived evidence also lacks Phase 4-specific 2/4-player profiles for both maps; native Windows/GPU 60FPS, physical audio/Internet feel and human Normal/Hard cause recognition/escape/rematch comparisons remain unverified. Preserve the existing human waiver and historical archive; do not retroactively claim these gates passed or start Phase 5 implementation.
